title: Baked falafel bowl with tahini sauce
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Drain the chickpeas well.
Pulse them in a food processor with the onion, garlic, herbs, cumin, salt and chickpea flour until coarse and shape into 12 small balls.
Place on a lined tray, brush with oil and bake for 20–25 minutes, turning halfway.
Stir the tahini with the soya yoghurt, lemon juice, salt and 2–3 tbsp water until smooth.
Divide the lettuce, tomatoes and cucumber between bowls, add the falafel and drizzle with the sauce.
